from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re,traceback
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

r=Path.cwd()
out=r/"reports/research/510300_202212_native_business_expectation_interpretation_source_v1"
at=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
target_url="https://www.stats.gov.cn/xxgk/jd/sjjd2020/202212/t20221231_1891399.html"
def rel(p):
    return str(Path(p).relative_to(r)).replace("\\","/")
def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name,d):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("本次产物已存在，禁止覆盖："+name)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,default=str)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p)}
assert sha(out/"protocol.json")=="4c1e1ea3761a5ee35fe38e30f4aeab84b67b0d8bf4bcd92104b32d7e2900b067"
if (out/"RUN_STARTED.json").exists():
    raise RuntimeError("已有首GET记录，不重复请求")
save("RUN_STARTED.json",{"at":at,"first_exact_title_result_url":target_url,
    "selection":"唯一官方查询中第一个精确2022年12月同期解读标题，不按数值选页",
    "new_queries_already_completed":1,"first_GET_budget":1,"retries":0})
try:
    response=requests.get(target_url,timeout=20,allow_redirects=False,headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
    raw=response.content
    rawpath=out/"官方202212解读_首次原始响应.html"
    rawpath.write_bytes(raw)
    receipt=save("官方原页首次收件_E122.json",{"at":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),
        "url":target_url,"status_code":response.status_code,"bytes":len(raw),"raw_path":rel(rawpath),"raw_sha256":sha(rawpath),
        "response_headers_subset":{k:v for k,v in response.headers.items() if k.lower() in ["content-type","last-modified","date","location"]},
        "first_GET_count":1,"redirects":0,"retries":0,"authenticated_requests":0})
    soup=BeautifulSoup(raw,"html.parser") if response.status_code==200 else None
    fulltext=soup.get_text("\n",strip=True) if soup else ""
    textpath=out/"官方解读完整可见原文_E122.txt"
    textpath.write_text(fulltext,encoding="utf-8")
    metas=[]
    if soup:
        for m in soup.find_all("meta"):
            name=m.get("name") or m.get("property") or ""
            content=m.get("content") or ""
            if any(s in name.lower() for s in ["pub","date","time","title","article","source"]):
                metas.append({"name":name,"content":content})
    exact_title="国家统计局服务业调查中心高级统计师赵庆河解读2022年12月中国采购经理指数"
    title_ok=exact_title in fulltext
    section=""
    if title_ok:
        i=fulltext.find("一、制造业")
        j=fulltext.find("二、非制造业",i) if i>=0 else -1
        section=fulltext[i:j if j>i else len(fulltext)] if i>=0 else ""
    normalized=re.sub(r"\s+","",section)
    matches=list(re.finditer(r"生产经营活动预期指数(?:为|是)?[：:]?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%",normalized))
    if not matches:
        matches=list(re.finditer(r"生产经营活动预期指数(?:为|是)?[：:]?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)",normalized))
    values=sorted(set(float(m.group(1)) for m in matches))
    value=values[0] if len(values)==1 and 0<=values[0]<=100 else None
    contexts=[]
    for m in re.finditer("预期",section):
        contexts.append(section[max(0,m.start()-60):m.end()+90])
    date_candidates=[]
    for meta in metas:
        if any(s in meta["name"].lower() for s in ["pubdate","publishdate","publishtime","pub_time","pubdate","published_time"]):
            if re.search(r"2022[-/]12[-/]31",meta["content"]):
                date_candidates.append(meta)
    visible_public_dates=re.findall(r"(?:发布(?:时间|日期)|发布时间)[：:\s]*([0-9]{4}[-/年][0-9]{1,2}[-/月][0-9]{1,2}(?:日)?(?:\s+[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}(?::[0-9]{2})?)?)",fulltext)
    date_known=bool(date_candidates or any("2022" in d and "12" in d and "31" in d for d in visible_public_dates))
    known_at="2022-12-31T23:59:59+08:00" if date_known else None
    clock_kind="原页发布元数据/显示日期保守当日结束；日内公开时刻未另认证" if date_known else "UNKNOWN_仅成文日期或日期未证明发布"
    full_article_ok=response.status_code==200 and title_ok and bool(section)
    passed=full_article_ok and value is not None and date_known
    source=save("当期制造业原量与原页公开钟裁决_E122.json",{"at":at,"url":target_url,"exact_title_ok":title_ok,
        "manufacturing_section_found":bool(section),"manufacturing_section_original":section,
        "expected_question_word_contexts":contexts,"current_native_business_expectation":value if value is not None else "UNKNOWN",
        "numeric_current_field_matches":[{"value":float(m.group(1)),"native_context":normalized[max(0,m.start()-40):m.end()+50]} for m in matches],
        "all_page_pub_title_meta":metas,"publication_date_meta_candidates":date_candidates,
        "visible_public_date_candidates":visible_public_dates,"own_known_at":known_at,"clock_kind":clock_kind,
        "formation_date_not_treated_as_publication":True,"later2023_01_search_result_not_used_to_reverse_fill":True,
        "first_vintage_authenticated":False,"source_admitted_for_new_separate_contract":passed,
        "old_E121_original_values_clocks_and_failures_not_changed":True})
    result={
        "at":at,"study_id":"510300_202212_NATIVE_BUSINESS_EXPECTATION_INTERPRETATION_SOURCE_V1","experiment_id":"E122",
        "status":"PASS_DIFFERENT_CURRENT_ORIGINAL_FIELD_AND_OWN_CLOCK_ONLY" if passed else
            "CLOSED_FIXED_OFFICIAL_INTERPRETATION_NO_ADMITTED_CURRENT_FIELD_OR_CLOCK",
        "official_url":target_url,"exact_title_ok":title_ok,"complete_manufacturing_section":full_article_ok,
        "current_native_business_expectation":value if value is not None else "UNKNOWN","own_known_at":known_at,
        "different_original_information_admitted":passed,"all_original1711_1212_joint_support":"NOT_RECHECKED_NOT_ADMITTED",
        "E121_source_candidate_closed_and_NOT_RUN_preserved":True,
        "new_queries":1,"new_first_GETs":1,"GET_status_code":response.status_code,"redirects":0,"retries":0,
        "authenticated_requests":0,"new_financial_candidates":0,"new_model_fits":0,"new_linear_regressions":0,
        "new_simple_weighted_scores":0,"new_stock_labels_read":0,"new_stock_labels_generated":0,
        "new_full_accounts":0,"existing_source_code_edits":0,
        "net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_status":"active","goal_achieved":False,
        "current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","prospective_forecasts":False,"orders_authorized":False,
        "first_vintage_authenticated":False,"independent_validation":False,"new_blind_sample":False,
        "evidence":[receipt,source,{"path":rel(textpath),"sha256":sha(textpath)}],
        "source_only_fixed_route_closed":True,"financial_stage":"NOT_RUN_SOURCE_ONLY",
        "current_action_change":"新增当期原数值且可核钟时才可另核共同支持" if passed else "本固定官方解读也未准入缺月原量，不能拟合/补值；本路线结束",
        "source_search_and_read_not_claimed_financial_success":True}
    save("result.json",result)
    print(json.dumps({"E122":result["status"],"原值":result["current_native_business_expectation"],
        "原公开钟":known_at,"原HTTP":response.status_code,"制造业预期词出现":len(contexts),
        "新查询/首GET":"1/1","金融模型/标签/账户":0,"source_result_sha256":sha(out/"result.json"),
        "制造业完整原段":section},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
except Exception:
    save("首次原页执行异常留证_E122.json",{"at":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),
        "traceback":traceback.format_exc(),"requested_url":target_url,"retries":0,
        "new_financial_models_labels_accounts":0,"existing_source_code_edits":0})
    raise
